$comment: Frozen shared contract for POST /api/documents/ingest. Mirrored byte-for-byte into the Igdrasil repository. HttpSink builds exactly this body; engine-api accepts exactly this body.

tenantAuthority.$comment: The token record is the only source of tenant truth. The header and the form field are cross-checks that can only cause rejection.

duplicateContent.$comment: A new idempotency key whose bytes were already ingested for this company.

replayedKey.$comment: A repeat Idempotency-Key. Reported as a duplicate delivery so the Collector does not count it as newly collected. HttpSink treats duplicate:true as deduped on any 2xx and on 409.

inFlight.$comment: A conflict that is NOT a duplicate must stay a delivery failure: HttpSink only accepts a 409 when duplicate === true.

slidingRenewal.$comment: A successful ingest extends the company token. The write is rate-bounded so a bulk collection does not issue one write per invoice. The renewed expiry is NOT returned to the Collector, so the extension's stored expiresAt is a floor from connect time — inactivity is measured from delivered invoices instead.
